body:
The biggest career mistake isn't a bad job. It's getting paid to do one narrow thing for years. 

Accounting, finance, data, marketing, coding, sales: AI is getting good at narrow tasks. The roles higher up need people who understand the whole business, from P&Ls to customers, partnerships and teams. 

Ascend, Mesa's Hybrid PGP in Business, AI & Entrepreneurship, helps you go wide in 12 months of weekends. For professionals with 5+ years of experience. Apply now.
headline: The #1 mistake mid-career pros make
